lines.text: 意大利在博吉亚家族治下三十年：战争、恐怖、谋杀、流血——却出了米开朗基罗、达·芬奇和文艺复兴。瑞士呢？兄弟之爱、五百年民主与和平——结果呢？咕咕钟。
lines.en: In Italy for 30 years under the Borgias they had warfare, terror, murder, and bloodshed, but they produced Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci, and the Renaissance. In Switzerland they had brotherly love—they had 500 years of democracy and peace, and what did that produce? The cuckoo clock.
lines.note: 哈里·莱姆在摩天轮上的犬儒演说（韦尔斯参与润色）：第三人把黑市道德做成历史笑话。通行定译略压缩。
